safeguardingPolicyRequirementsV1.authorityRule: Only a published human-governed policy version supplies values; AI output cannot create, alter, waive or select them.

invariants: One Event has exactly one owningGroupId and one accountable owner.
Visibility and sponsorship are independent dimensions.
A Child Event has at most one parent level.
Every Event has at least one EventOccurrence; one-off Events have exactly one initial occurrence.
Every schema 1.1 creation has one globally unique activityTypeCode belonging to its archetype; legacy snapshots keep it null.
The four archetype codes and their structure/security semantics are immutable system settings; event templates may be created only inside those four categories.
The event-template catalogue starts with sixteen system presets at version 2. Template code and archetypeCode are immutable; edit, activate and deactivate create an audited next version.
Only the current active template version is accepted for schema 1.1 compose, recompose and create. Deactivation never rewrites an existing Event or EventPlanSnapshot.
Activity-type presets never confirm child, RAM, transport, money, venue or capacity facts, and MONEY.FINANCE is never type-preselected.

Every initial system-preset activity type version 2 preselects SERVICE.ROSTER and supplies a non-empty, bilingual, editable presetServiceSlots list. Any later template that preselects SERVICE.ROSTER must do the same; accepting a plan creates unassigned slots per occurrence with that occurrence's start/end, while declining SERVICE.ROSTER creates none.
Preset service-slot counts are planning defaults only: they never establish safeguarding policy, worker-to-child ratios, eligibility policy or member assignment.
Missing or candidate facts never satisfy a confirmed false condition.
Compose and recompose never mutate persisted event state.
Only explicit human acceptance creates an immutable EventPlanSnapshot.
An accepted snapshot retains every referenced archetype, module and policy version.
A module with persisted operational data cannot be removed silently.
EventWorkflowRun, Step and Artifact remain the single general workflow engine.
AI cannot confirm facts, assign authority, approve, waive, sponsor, persist or publish.
Unknown modules, policies, enum values and surface keys fail closed.
Product wire text remains { en, zh }; document locale zh-Hant does not change the key.
Only an approved sanitised public projection may enter shared cache.

architectureDecisions.decision: Official sponsorship requires root-church leader/co-leader or admin.events.sponsor approval.
Each Event has one owning group and accountable owner; other teams are contributors.
Child Events are one level deep and require an independent lifecycle boundary.
The system owns module codes, integration executors and surface keys.
Churches may name safe bilingual templates but cannot assemble arbitrary permissions.
Policies are non-waivable unless a versioned policy explicitly allows an audited exception.
Recurring series maintain a rolling 12-week occurrence window in an IANA time zone.
Four archetypes are immutable system categories; authorised administrators manage immutable versions of templates within them.
